worldcombat.skill.teatime.summary: Spreads out a tea party at the chosen spot: every combatant holding a Berry inside the aroma (allies, foes and the user alike) eats its own Berry, and the effect lands on the eater. It can set allies' Berries off at once, or force a foe to spend a healing or reactive Berry early. A grand tea is wider, lasts longer and brews stronger, at the cost of a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.teatime.use.0: Pitch a tea among a cluster of foes and strip a whole group of its Berries
worldcombat.skill.teatime.use.1: Set allies' healing or stat Berries off right away
worldcombat.skill.teatime.use.2: Force a foe's reactive Berry out early
worldcombat.skill.teatime.description.0: The aroma reaches %1$s blocks; every Berry holder inside eats its own Berry (the user included).
worldcombat.skill.teatime.description.1: Serve within %1$s blocks, with steam lasting %2$s and about %3$s cup and plate particles.
worldcombat.skill.teatime.description.2: The brew scales Berry healing by %1$s; about %2$s tea motes; wind-up %3$s, recovery %4$s and cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.teatime.stance.grand: Grand: x1.3 radius, x1.4 duration, x1.3 cups and x1.1 brew, at the cost of +3 ticks of wind-up and a longer cooldown - for a big spread.
worldcombat.skill.teatime.stance.quick: Quick: x0.8 radius, a faster and cheaper cast - for simply stripping a foe's Berry as soon as possible.
worldcombat.skill.teatime.timing: Cast at a chosen point; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.teatime.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.teatime.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.teatime.preference.gra: On: x1.3 radius, x1.4 duration, x1.3 cups and x1.1 brew, with +3 ticks of wind-up and a longer cooldown. Off: x0.8 radius with a faster, cheaper cast.
At least this many Berry holders must be inside the tea before it is worth serving; 1 serves for a single Berry, higher waits for more to eat together.
The tea is considered only when a threat is within this distance; lower pitches only up close, higher closes a gap first.
On: the tea is served only when at least one foe inside holds a Berry, purely to strip them. Off: also served when enough Berry holders are around, to set allies' Berries off.
world_combat.move.teatime.text.served: Tea is served; %1$s eat their held Berry
world_combat.move.teatime.text.empty: No one held a Berry; the tea is wasted
